achievements.name: Bound Companions
achievements.detail: Leave on the journey with the companions who join your party.

achievements.name: Vision Called
achievements.detail: Bring a Vision into battle, an echo of a hero from an earlier tale.

achievements.name: Stagger
achievements.detail: Strike an enemy's weakness until it staggers and your side takes extra turns.

achievements.name: Resonance
achievements.detail: After a stagger, fire a Resonance attack to use that opening.

achievements.name: Vision Party
achievements.detail: Enter a fight with your companions and at least two Visions together.

achievements.name: Esper
achievements.detail: Gain an esper's aid and carry that summon with you.

achievements.name: Moogle
achievements.detail: Meet a moogle out in the world.

achievements.name: Airship
achievements.detail: Fly an airship from one part of the map to another.

achievements.name: Gilgamesh
achievements.detail: Meet Gilgamesh, the swordmaster who wanders from place to place.

achievements.name: Colosseum
achievements.detail: Win a Colosseum bout and collect the reward for that fight.

achievements.name: Chamber of Arms
achievements.detail: Beat a foe sealed in one of the legendary weapons kept in the Chamber of Arms.

achievements.name: Ultima Weapon
achievements.detail: Defeat Ultima Weapon in the showdown against it.
